title: oenothera biennis f. muricata
intro: Oenothera biennis f. muricata, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a plant species in the Onagraceae family. It is native to North America and is known for its medicinal properties. Evening Primrose has been used to support women's health, particularly in alleviating symptoms of premenstrual syndrome (PMS) and menopausal symptoms, due to its health benefits which include reducing inflammation and improving heart health. The therapeutic actions of Evening Primrose are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), linoleic acid, and other unsaturated fatty acids.
